beats.text: One in five married men has cheated. And women? Closer than you think.
A big national survey asked married Americans one question: have you ever had sex with someone else while married?
Twenty percent of men said yes. Thirteen percent of women.
But under thirty, women were slightly ahead. Eleven percent versus ten.
The highest rate of all? Men in their seventies. Twenty-six percent.
So the real cheater is older than the stereotype. And most people never do it.

sources: Wang (2018), Institute for Family Studies: 'Who cheats more? The demographics of infidelity in America', analysis of the General Social Survey. Ever-married: 20% of men, 13% of women had sex with someone other than spouse while married; ages 18-29: women 11% vs men 10%; men in their 70s 26% (highest).
